takeaways: Chat-only Copilot shifts work into context switching; interactive components rendered in the Copilot canvas let users act where the answer appears.

Choose SPFx when SharePoint is the system of record to inherit tenant identity, permissions, DLP and audit, and choose MCP for cross-system orchestration only if you can fund the extra security engineering.
Fix permissions, classify data with sensitivity labels and enforce DLP before broad Copilot rollout, because the agent fabric amplifies weak governance instead of fixing it.
hook: Copilot as a chat box creates walls of text and endless switching between SharePoint, Excel and Outlook. This episode is for M365 architects, SharePoint developers and IT leaders and explains why interactive SPFx and MCP components, upcoming licensing changes and a governance-first approach decide whether enterprise AI actually speeds up work.
